mapper.select: SELECT id, auto_backup_enabled, auto_backup_type, auto_backup_cron, backup_path, remote_backup_enabled, remote_host, remote_port, remote_username, remote_password, remote_path, updated_at FROM backup_config LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO backup_config (auto_backup_enabled, auto_backup_type, auto_backup_cron, backup_path, remote_backup_enabled, remote_host, remote_port, remote_username, remote_password, remote_path) VALUES (#{autoBackupEnabled}, #{autoBackupType}, #{autoBackupCron}, #{backupPath}, #{remoteBackupEnabled}, #{remoteHost}, #{remotePort}, #{remoteUsername}, #{remotePassword}, #{remotePath})
mapper.update: UPDATE backup_config SET auto_backup_enabled = #{autoBackupEnabled}, auto_backup_type = #{autoBackupType}, auto_backup_cron = #{autoBackupCron}, backup_path = #{backupPath}, remote_backup_enabled = #{remoteBackupEnabled}, remote_host = #{remoteHost}, remote_port = #{remotePort}, remote_username = #{remoteUsername}, remote_password = #{remotePassword}, remote_path = #{remotePath}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
